title: Nutty Crunchy Spanish Gorgonzola Pasta
description: Buttery and crunchy Spanish inspired pasta dish featuring gorgonzola dolce, with an al dente finish, this satvik friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat
Add the chopped hazelnuts to the skillet and cook until fragrant and lightly toasted
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute
Stir in the crumbled gorgonzola dolce and cook until melted and smooth
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the gorgonzola sauce
Season with salt and black pepper to taste
Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately
